children: Overview
UK mobile gaming licensor's H1 content licensing revenue rose 12%, but total revenue fell 3%
Adjusted EBITDA excluding brand licensing grew 16%, but total adjusted EBITDA declined 12%
Company expanded into four new regulated markets and increased unique players by 88%
Outlook
Gaming Realms expects FY26 results to be in line with market expectations
Company plans further international expansion and new regulated market entries in H2 2026
Gaming Realms to release more Slingo and Lucky Lunar titles and invest in platform technology
Result Drivers
NEW MARKETS & PARTNERS - Co said content licensing growth was driven by launches in new regulated markets and 22 new operator partnerships
PRODUCT EXPANSION - Co cited increased game releases, including 11 new titles and the launch of the Lucky Lunar studio, as supporting revenue growth
UK RESILIENCE - Co said UK revenues grew 3% despite a near doubling of Remote Gaming Duty, reflecting resilience of the Slingo brand and recent product innovations
